### [Investing in the public benefit](https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-18

Anthropic is committing 5% of its shares to a new wholly-owned LLC, the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, to support public benefit initiatives as the company grows.

- Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic's shares will be committed immediately, with an optional 2% added per 50% increase in company value above a set baseline.
- The Public Benefit Fund is structured as a wholly-owned LLC rather than a 501(c)(3) to allow flexibility across different giving formats, excluding lobbying and political contributions.
- Combined with co-founder equity pledges (80%) and an employee equity match program, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares are currently dedicated to public benefit.
- The fund will support initiatives such as non-profit donations, direct population distributions, and addressing AI labor market impacts, building on $200 million already committed to labor research.

**Why it matters:** The structure dynamically ties Anthropic's corporate valuation growth to an increasing percentage of equity allocated directly for broad public benefit initiatives.
